[LINT.4.5] **Interval relational operators require Interval
operands.** Where an operand is a non-Interval *literal* —
`5 contains 3` — it is a compile error
(`DS_VALIDATE_INTERVAL_REL_NON_INTERVAL`). An operand whose
type is not statically known (a `Json` value, a bound slot) is
not rejected here; it resolves under the ordinary type rules.
